tests.about: Identical, related and unrelated sentence pairs are compared. Identical sentences must score about 1, and related sentences clearly higher than unrelated ones.

inputs.label: identical sentences
inputs.value: I love watching sunny sunsets at the beach.  |  I love watching sunny sunsets at the beach.

inputs.label: related sentences
inputs.value: I love watching sunny sunsets at the beach.  |  Warm ocean evenings are wonderful.

inputs.label: unrelated sentences
inputs.value: I love watching sunny sunsets at the beach.  |  The quarterly tax filing deadline is next Tuesday.

tests.about: The two sentences of the notebook are compared, and one of them with itself. Identical sentences must score 1 and different ones less, within the baseline measured on release 1.2.3.
tests.note: The two sentences of the notebook. This model does not order sentences by meaning: on release 1.2.3 an unrelated pair of sentences scored higher (0.99) than a related one (0.97). So no ordering by meaning is asserted, and the similarity is compared with a BASELINE measured on release 1.2.3 (CPU).
